    • Council selects Mayor, Deputy Mayor

Council selects Mayor, Deputy Mayor

  • Facebook
  • LinkedIn
  • Twitter
  • Email

Councilmember Karen Howe will now serve Sammamish as Mayor and Councilmember Amy Lam has stepped back into the role of Deputy Mayor after unanimous votes of the Council meeting Jan. 7. Kali Clark stepped down as Mayor to complete law school but will finish her term as a councilmember.  

Published: Jan 08, 2025
